selection_basis: one final architecture-diverse local challenger selected for operational reliability and task calibration only; no Gemma market outcome or trading return exists or may be consulted

candidate.rationale: different model family from the evaluated Llama and Qwen candidates, instruction-tuned, and small enough to run as one local worker within the 6 GB GPU constraint

stage1_operational_gate.sampling: twelve deterministic calendar samples per year for 2017-2025
stage1_operational_gate.decision: all requirements must pass; otherwise reject the challenger and stop before full inference, calibration or backtest

stage2_only_if_stage1_passes.work: one full 2927-record inference followed by outcome calibration only
stage2_only_if_stage1_passes.decision: all requirements must pass before authorizing a full repeat, consensus construction or any lifecycle trading backtest

prohibited: consulting Gemma trading return during model selection
changing prompt or action thresholds within this experiment
adding further direct-direction model challengers after this predeclared final challenger
running multiple heavy jobs or LLM workers
continuing compute at NVIDIA GPU temperature 75 C or above

baseline_reference.qwen35_4b_status: not promoted because a pre-existing outcome-free pilot already showed a schema/range failure
